item.title: Rallying Cry – November 10, 2026
item.description: Science is making breakthroughs in restoring speech, Japan’s school programs are boosting learning in Madagascar, octopuses reveal their sneaky escape secrets, and the US just saw majority opposition to the death penalty for the first time in over 50 years.
